verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs explicitly list a broad range of integer quantization support—INT8, INT4, GPTQ/AWQ, GGUF, compressed-tensors—covering 8-bit down to very low-bit precision, directly matching the story's ask (vllm-docs-4). One old community comment suggests 4-bit wasn't supported in an early version, but current docs indicate this gap has been closed.
